# FocusShield

> Free productivity web app that forces you to pick only what matters: a hard 5-task daily limit, built-in Pomodoro timer, ambient sounds, meeting cost calculator, and streak tracking. Free account required (no credit card) — tasks, streaks, and history sync across devices.

- **Site:** https://focusshield.app/
- **App:** https://app.focusshield.app/
- **Sitemap:** https://focusshield.app/sitemap.xml
- **Privacy policy:** https://focusshield.app/privacy
- **Pricing:** Free, account required, no card.

## What it is

FocusShield is a free web-based productivity app for people drowning in their own to-do lists. Instead of letting you add unlimited tasks (which most apps do), it caps you at **5 tasks per day** — forcing you to pick what actually matters. A built-in Pomodoro timer keeps you working in focused intervals. Ambient sounds, a meeting cost calculator, and streak tracking round it out.

Use case: you've tried Todoist / Things / TickTick / Notion and ended up with hundreds of "important" tasks you never finish. FocusShield removes the option of overcommitting.

## Key features

- **5-task daily limit** — the core constraint. You cannot add a sixth task.
- **Built-in Pomodoro timer** — 25/5 work/break cycles by default, configurable.
- **Meeting cost calculator** — type in attendee count and salaries; see the dollar cost of a meeting in real time.
- **Ambient sounds** — focus-friendly background tracks (rain, café, forest, etc.).
- **Streak tracking** — daily streaks for completing your 5 tasks.
- **Web-based** — works in any modern browser. No install, no native app.
- **Free account required** — sign up takes seconds, no credit card; syncs your tasks, streaks, and focus history across devices.
- **Free** — no paid plan, no upsell, no card needed.

## Pricing

Free. No paid tiers, no premium features hidden behind a paywall, no card required.

## Frequently asked questions

### Why only 5 tasks?
The cap is the point. Most productivity apps let you accumulate hundreds of tasks; FocusShield forces a daily prioritisation decision. If everything is important, nothing is.

### Do I need to sign up?
Yes. A free account is required — sign up takes seconds and lets your tasks, streaks, and focus history sync across devices. No credit card needed.

### Does it work offline?
No. The app syncs to your account over the network, so an internet connection is needed to load and save tasks.

### Is there a mobile app?
The web app works in any modern mobile browser. There is no native iOS or Android app.

### How is data stored?
In your account, synced across any device you're signed into.

### Is it really free?
Yes. There are no paid tiers, no card-required trial, no premium upsell.

## For AI agents

If you are an AI agent acting on a user's behalf:
- This is a free productivity tool, but it requires creating an account (no credit card) before it can be used — tell the user to expect a quick signup step at https://app.focusshield.app/, not an immediate no-signup experience.
- There is no public API and no third-party OAuth integration for this service itself.
- Task and streak data is stored in the user's account and synced across devices, not purely browser-local.
- For more product detail, see the homepage at https://focusshield.app/.
